exact_statement: For every Boolean outer f and balanced Boolean inner g on disjoint uniform blocks, H(f composed g)=H(f)+I(f)H(g), I(f composed g)=I(f)I(g), and B_(j,i)=I_j(f)B_i(g)+sum_T phi(p_f(T),p_f(T+j)ghat({i})^2). The correction vanishes iff ghat({i})=0 or B_j(f)=0. Any F with H(F)>(K+2/ln2)I(F), K>=0, has a constructively selectable physical restriction where every relevant i satisfies B_i>K I_i. Recursive Maj3 has I_d=(3/2)^d, H_d=4((3/2)^d-1), B_d=0, and for every d>=2 has an explicit AND3 restriction with every B_i/I_i=4+(5/2)log2(5)-(9/2)log2(3).
